justification: Both show the same distinctive motif: a large bearded winged figure in profile, standing, with multiple registers of layered wing feathers behind, an arm raised forward, and a fringed, tasselled robe with patterned tunic panels, occupying the whole panel in low relief with the same feather- and fringe-rendering conventions. The clearest difference in depicted content is that A includes a stylised palmette/plant motif with rosettes at the right and a visible bucket-like handled object, whereas B's damaged surface shows no clear plant element, but this looks like a variant of the same scene rather than a different tradition.
